items.body: The amounts 407 and 600 to 700 billion do not price the same thing. The first relates to the contractually stated price of two units at the 2023 price level; higher public estimates add further layers, especially financing and time. The price of electricity in euros per megawatt-hour is, moreover, a different indicator from the acquisition account of the construction. What we know / What we do not know What we know: The publicly announced base EPC price is 407 billion Kč in 2023 prices; first fuel is booked separately. The price of the works, financing and the unit price of electricity are distinct quantities. What we do not know: Complete indexation formulae, the final koruna cost of financing and the future settlement of the contract for difference cannot be reliably calculated from public materials. 1. Three columns that pose as one price Imagine a meeting on the “price of Dukovany”. The industry minister points to 407 billion in the contract with KHNP and says that the construction price has not changed. The finance minister points to the state loan and says that without the cost of money the account is incomplete. The head of EDU II notes that 407 billion is in 2023 reference prices. The director of ČEPS recalls that two units will not connect themselves to the grid. The fuel specialist has a separate contract for 15 billion. The journalist in the room has two numbers in the notebook: 400 and 700. He wants to know which is a lie. At first glance this is a dispute about truth-telling. In fact each person describes a different object. The first speaks about the overnight EPC price. The second speaks about interest. The third speaks about indexation. The fourth speaks about regulated infrastructure outside the plant fence. The fifth speaks about fuel. The journalist compares headline with headline. Individual actors may quote a correct figure and still run a misleading dispute if they do not name its accounting boundaries. The question “how much do Dukovany cost” must be split into the construction price without financing, the cost of money over time, and separately the unit price of the electricity produced. The first important distinction therefore is not who lied. It is which object is being read just now . Otherwise we set an engine, a loan instalment and the price of a kilometre side by side and are surprised that each number wins in a different discipline. Overnight is not a lie. It is an account without time. Seven hundred billion is not an admission of collapse. It is an account with time. Neither of them is LCOE. — Jiný Kontext One plant, several accounts An illustrative chain of layers between the contracted plant price and who pays the bill. One plant, several accounts Overnight Indexation Interest Outside EPC Payer JINÝ KONTEXT Illustrative diagram: The chain shows what a figure can contain; it is not a breakdown of a specific invoice or an audit of final costs. 2. What exactly the price of two units contains When “the price of the power plant” appears in a headline, it is easy to get the impression that there is one invoice. The result, however, is produced in a chain of several layers. Each can raise the amount, lower it, or merely shift it onto another payer. Two figures about the same project therefore need not be a dispute. They may be two views of the same chain — and a third view, LCOE, is no longer a view of the same chain at all. Five layers of the construction and fiscal account Overnight EPC price: reactor, turbine, construction works and the supplier’s technology in reference prices, as if the works stood overnight, without interest. At Dukovany this is a contract for 407 billion Kč in 2023 prices for two units. [3] [4] Escalation and indexation: contractual formulae that move the overnight price over time according to inflation, currency and materials. The public text is partly blacked out; the precise formulae cannot be calculated from it. [4] [5] Cost of money: interest and capital costs for the period while construction proceeds. In August 2026 Havlíček added this layer to the construction component and obtained the interval 600–700 billion . This is a minister’s estimate, not an audit by the Ministry of Finance. [6] Related items outside EPC: preparation, licences, first fuel loads, grid reinforcement. This layer is not broken down in Havlíček’s sum. Payer: who pays the account — EDU II, state debt, the ČEPS tariff, the fuel contract, the nuclear account. The same koruna may disappear from the headline because someone else pays it. The base contract determines an important part of the costs, but it is not the only actor. The state may provide a low-interest loan that changes layer 3 without changing layer 1. ČEPS may reinforce 400 kV lines without that appearing on the KHNP invoice. Fuel may cost 15 billion in a special contract and vanish from the headline “price of the units”. [3] [4] LCOE does not belong on this list. It is not a sixth billion-item. It is a different object: the estimated price of one megawatt-hour, which only then combines capital, fuel, operation, the life of the unit and the discount. Mixing it with 407 or with 700 means adding kilograms and kilometres. This is not a dispute about vocabulary. The cut of the layers determines where to turn at an apparent jump. The difference between 400 and 407 billion may be the difference between rounded communication and the precisely stated contract amount. The move from 407 to 600–700 billion may mean adding the cost of money. The amount “90 euros” already points to the unit price of electricity and the CfD mechanism. The sentence “the project has become more expensive” is therefore the start of scrutiny, not its end. Illustrative diagram: Overnight, the cost of money and LCOE are not three names for the same thing. They are three objects: the price of the works without time, interest from time, the unit price of electricity. 3. The best account is the one whose substitution you recognise One “correct” number is not enough until the price year, the items included and the unit are stated. Substituting the overnight price for financing can be repaired by adding a legend. Substituting both quantities for LCOE is more serious, because it mixes billions for construction with the euro for a megawatt-hour produced. Type of failure What it looks like How to test it What limits the harm Substitution of overnight and interest 400 is read as 700, or the reverse Write beside the number: EPC, or EPC + cost of money? A mandatory legend with every amount Substitution of billions and LCOE 407 bn is “converted” into 90 EUR/MWh Ask about the unit: Kč, or EUR/MWh? Separate sentences, not one sum Escalation without a formula The invoice grows, the public sees only 407 Is the clause readable, or blacked out? An auditable index, not an impression from the register A foreign payer in the headline The grid or fuel is added to KHNP Who pays the invoice? A map of payers Time Delay is read as dearer concrete Which column grew: the works, interest, or both? Milestones, not a single headline This also changes the reader’s question. We do not ask only which number is lower. We ask which account will fail in a way that we catch in the debate. A newsroom may tolerate rounding 407 to 400, because it is the same overnight. It cannot tolerate interest becoming “the Koreans raised the price”. Analysts may accept the interval 600–700 as a political estimate. They cannot issue it as LCOE. Beside feasibility, what matters for a project is whether the account can be traced, its layers separated and the impact of substitution quantified. A less flashy number with a clear legend is more useful for public scrutiny than an amount without a definition. 4. Overnight captures only the price without time Overnight cost is needed because it replaces part of the impressions with an internationally intelligible metric. IEA and OECD-NEA define it as the price of the plant as if it were built “overnight”: without interest during construction and without escalation over time. Interest during construction is a separate item. To confuse the two figures is the same error as confusing the catalogue price of a flat with a mortgage instalment. [8] [21] The problem arises at the moment when one overnight score begins to represent the whole fiscal account, or conversely the whole price of electricity. It is a map of one object. It is not a verdict on how much the state will pay on bonds, nor on what a household will see on the bill. Every overnight number contains hidden decisions. Prices of which year? How many units? Is fuel in it? Which currencies? Is it an offer, or a signed contract? The answer to any of these questions can change the comparison with EDF, with Poland or with a 2024 headline. Five facts without which “the price of the power plant” is only an advertising number The exact object: overnight EPC, EPC after escalation, or EPC plus the cost of money. The price year and the currency. The number of units and whether it is an option or a commitment. Whether the number is a contract, an offer, or a minister’s estimate. What is expressly not in it: fuel, the grid, LCOE. For buying and for reading, therefore, a small internal breakdown matters more than a foreign overall ranking of “the cheapest nuclear in Europe”. Thirty rows with the same object will say more than a thousand headlines from another layer. Public overnight helps select a supplier. The fiscal decision must be made by the cost of money. The bill component must be made by LCOE and CfD. The same project, different objects Plant cost, time, another payer and the unit price of electricity are not the same thing. The same project, different objects Overnight Time Other payer LCOE Plant cost JINÝ KONTEXT Interpretive diagram: Position and size do not express a share of costs; the diagram only separates objects that headlines mix together. 5. Compare columns, not headlines The table assigns each public amount a concrete object: an offer, EPC, fuel, financing or the unit price of electricity. For each row it states the substitution that needs to be caught when reading. Message Main object What to verify Typical reason for use “200 billion per unit” (July 2024) Overnight offer with two units Price year, number of units, whether without interest Comparison of bidders “407 billion” (contract 2025) Overnight EPC, 2023 prices, two units Escalation, currency, blacking-out Contractual anchor “15 billion fuel” A separate fuel contract That it is not in 407 First loads, not LCOE “600–700 billion” (August 2026) Construction component + cost of money Author: a minister’s estimate, not an audit Fiscal sum “Under 90 EUR/MWh” A political target for the unit price 2024 prices, relation to CfD, not to EPC The bill, not the construction The rows are not a verdict on truth-telling. The same speaker may use three objects during one conference. The map is meant to prevent a different error: that 407 becomes 700 and 700 becomes 90 euros in one sentence. How to read the diagram: The position of a number in a headline does not express which object it measures. The diagram separates the overnight price, financing and LCOE. 6. Two hundred billion per unit was overnight On 17 July 2024 the government of the Czech Republic confirmed the Korean company KHNP as the preferred supplier for the construction of two units at the Dukovany site, with an option for a further two units at Temelín. In the last phase the bids of KHNP and EDF stood against each other. Westinghouse had been eliminated earlier. [1] [19] Redakční ilustrace · Jiný Kontext Government communication then set side by side three things that are not the same: An offered price of around 200 billion koruna for one unit if two units were built at the same time — an overnight comparison of bidders. A state financing model: interest-free repayable financial assistance during construction, after commissioning interest at 1 % above the cost of state debt, at least 2 %. A guarantee of electricity offtake, which belongs to LCOE and CfD, not to overnight. [1] [7] Into the media space came the sum 2 × 200 = 400 billion Kč. At the same press conference representatives described that credit financing would run separately. The headline took the first sentence. It postponed the second. The third — offtake — returned as “90 euros”, which is again a different object. That is not necessarily fraud. It is a selective optic. The figure of 200 billion per unit was intelligible and comparable with the competitor. The cost of money depends on the length of construction and the drawdown profile. LCOE depends still on production and the discount. Anyone who wants a single number in 2024 gets overnight. Anyone who wants fiscal reality must wait for the column that was not then published as an audit. On 30 April 2024 the European Commission approved the state-aid package SA.58207: an offtake contract, repayable financial assistance and investment protection. The notification originally concerned one unit of up to 1 200 MW. The political decision on two units came later. Here too it holds that the legal envelope, the overnight contract and LCOE are not the same. [7] [22] 7. The contract holds 407 billion. It does not state the final invoice On 4 June 2025, hours after the Supreme Administrative Court lifted the preliminary measure of the Regional Court in Brno, Elektrárna Dukovany II and KHNP signed the main EPC contract. The signature was electronic. [2] [3] [17] The publicly known parameters are narrow and yet decisive: The base contract price of construction of two units: 407 billion koruna in 2023 reference prices. The contract for first deliveries of nuclear fuel: 15 billion koruna , separately. The difference against the previously communicated roughly 400 billion was explained by the investor among other things by the currency mix — part of the costs in koruna, part in euros. [3] [4] [5] Public communication describes 407 billion as an overnight price. The contract in the register is partly blacked out: passages on price, completion time and subcontracts. According to EDU II this is security and intellectual property. According to a reader of the account it means that precise indexation formulae cannot be calculated from the public text . The final invoice therefore need not stay at 407 billion. That is still not the interest on the state loan and not LCOE. [4] [5] The contract at the same time gives the state as majority owner of EDU II control over subcontractors. The political pledge speaks of roughly 60 % participation of Czech firms. That is industrial policy. It is not an overnight item, it is not an interest item and it is not LCOE. [2] [18] Four hundred and seven hundred are not the same An account without time and an account with time answer different questions. Four hundred and seven hundred are not the same Without time With time Overnight EPC Interest Indexation Two accounts JINÝ KONTEXT Interpretive diagram: The sides are not a share estimate; they separate the overnight price from the layer that adds time and the cost of money. 8. Escalation is not interest Escalation moves layer 1 over time. The cost of money adds layer 3. Anyone who adds both into one “jump of 300 billion” mixes two mechanisms. Anyone who conversely claims that 407 billion is the final amount the state will ever pay conceals both — and LCOE on top. Indexation is contractual. Interest is financial. The first depends on the basket of prices and currencies in the contract. The second depends on the rate of state assistance, the length of construction and the drawdown profile. A complete public model of both components as of 31 August 2026 is missing. It does not follow that escalation is zero. It follows that it cannot be calculated from a headline. Act No. 367/2021 Coll. sets the domestic envelope of a low-carbon source and the state’s relation to the investor. It too does not calculate escalation, interest or LCOE. It says who may guarantee what. [14] 9. The cost of money: what Havlíček added to the construction component Karel Havlíček told Novinky in August 2026: “When we look at how much the new nuclear units at Dukovany will cost, it will be twice two hundred billion koruna, and with that, with the cost of money, we are at six to seven hundred billion koruna for two large units.” [6] The sentence is precise in what it adds: the construction component and the cost of money. It is not a new item in the contract with KHNP. It is not proof that EPC jumped by hundreds of billions. It is not LCOE. It is a political sum of two objects, of which the first was in the headline in 2024 and the second in brackets. The publicly described model counts on low-interest repayable financial assistance: 0 % during construction, after commissioning 1 % above the state’s interest, at least 2 %. That is a decision about who bears the price of time. It is not a gift or a discount from EPC. How much interest piles up in koruna depends on the rate, the length of construction, the drawdown profile and the precise contractual definition. A complete public audit of this column as of 31 August 2026 is not in the cited materials. The interval 600–700 billion is a minister’s estimate, not financial statements. [1] [6] [7] IEA and OECD-NEA show that capital costs can form tens of percent of LCOE . That is a sentence about the composition of the megawatt-hour price. It is not a sentence that interest is half of the EPC contract. To confuse a share in LCOE with adding hundreds of billions to 407 is precisely the substitution of objects this text resists. [8] [10] What needs to be separated The first separation concerns vocabulary. “Cost overrun” makes sense when the same column grows over time. It does not make sense when overnight is for the first time joined by what was never in it from the start. The second concerns the author. Havlíček’s interval is not an SAO report. The third concerns scope. It says “with the cost of money”. It does not say “including the grid and fuel”. It does not say “90 euros”. 10. What someone else pays is not a KHNP price rise The full balance of the project reaches beyond the plant fence. Some items are paid by the investor. Others by the regulated grid operator. Others by the fuel contract. Others by a levy on the megawatt-hour produced. Adding them into one headline is possible. It is not the same as a price rise of the contract with KHNP and it is not LCOE. Item Publicly stated amount Payer Relation to 407 and to 600–700 EPC, two units 407 bn Kč, 2023 prices EDU II / state loan Overnight anchor [3] First fuel 15 bn Kč EDU II, separate contract Outside 407; not broken down in 600–700 [4] Preparation, land, licences A public single sum is missing from the cited materials Investor Outside EPC; the amount cannot be determined here Transmission reinforcement An item of ČEPS’s ten-year plan, not a KHNP item System tariff Outside both headlines [11] Deep geological repository A long-term SÚRAO estimate, collected by a levy per MWh Nuclear account A different time, a different payer [16] Anyone who adds these rows to 600–700 billion gets a higher sum of different payers. Anyone who issues them as proof that “the Koreans raised the price” makes an accounting error. Anyone who erases them because “they are not in the contract” undervalues the tariff footprint. The correct sentence is narrow: a column of foreign payers exists, it is not the content of Havlíček’s interval and it is not LCOE . 11. LCOE is not a construction account For a household it is not the investment amount in billions itself that decides, but the unit price of wholesale electricity. LCOE — Levelized Cost of Electricity — spreads capital, fuel, operation, maintenance and the cost of capital over expected production during the life of the unit. The unit is EUR/MWh or Kč/MWh . It is not a billion in EPC. It is not Havlíček’s interval. [8] [10] That is why a cheaper overnight construction with expensive capital can come out worse in LCOE than a dearer construction with a state loan. And that is why the same 407 billion can mean a different bill according to whether the unit runs for 60 or 80 years and whether it starts in 2036 or four years later. That is not a dispute about 400 versus 700. It is a third object. The government declared the target that electricity from the new units would not exceed 90 EUR/MWh in 2024 prices. The prime minister repeated it at the signing of the contracts on 4 June 2025. That is a political ceiling on the unit price. It is not overnight. It is not 600–700. It is not a market prediction. It is not LCOE calculated by an independent auditor from open contract data. [2] [7] IEA/NEA in Projected Costs of Generating Electricity show that the ranking of technologies turns with the discount rate. At 3 % nuclear looks different than at 7 % and 10 %. MIT in The Future of Nuclear Energy in a Carbon-Constrained World adds another axis: not only price, but also the system’s ability to carry night and winter load. Neither study claims that Czech 90 EUR is guaranteed. Both claim that capital and time decide in LCOE more than a slogan about concrete — which is again a sentence about a megawatt-hour, not about 407 billion. [8] [9] Lazard’s LCOE is a map of the market. It is not a judgment on Dukovany. It works with other regions, other WACC and other assumptions about construction. It is an audit of one methodology of one firm, not proof that Czech overnight has no value. It does show, however, that even a precise euro may precisely measure a different question. [10] How not to mix LCOE with billions Ask about the unit. If the answer is in billions, it is not LCOE. If it is in euros per megawatt-hour, it is not EPC. If someone “converts” 407 billion into 90 euros by one division without production, life and discount, he has not calculated LCOE. He has composed two maps into one number. 12. How CfD allocates price risk The contract-for-difference mechanism is not a discount on construction. In a simplified example, at a reference market price of 110 EUR/MWh and a strike of 90 the support recipient would pay the difference to the contractual counterparty; at a reference price of 60 the difference would be topped up the other way. Actual settlement depends on the definition of the reference price, the settlement period, indexation and the precise wording of the contract. The figures are an illustration of the principle, not a calculation of the Czech tariff or a future household invoice. [7] [10] Redakční ilustrace · Jiný Kontext In decision SA.58207 the European Commission assessed offtake, the state loan and protection against a change of policy. It approved it as compatible with the internal market. Approval is not a stamp of advantageousness. It is a legal condition. The strike in the notification and the political target “under 90 EUR” may differ in definition, inflation clause and in whether they applied to one unit or to two. [7] [22] For the reader two sentences follow. First: 407 and 600–700 do not automatically determine the price on the bill. Second: CfD redistributes risk between the producer and the contractual counterparty. A higher or lower reference price may change the direction of the balancing payment, but the impact on the state budget, the tariff and the retail price is, without a final contract and regulation, neither direct nor quantified in advance. 13. Flamanville: three objects, three jumps When assessing risks it is necessary to take into account the history of large nuclear constructions in the West. Not in order to make Dukovany into Flamanville in advance. In order that it be visible which object ran away abroad. Flamanville 3 in France began with an estimate of 3.3 billion EUR in 2007 and a planned start in 2012. EDF states a construction cost of 13.2 billion EUR in 2015 prices, without financing. The French court of audit in January 2025 arrived at 23.7 billion EUR including interest in 2023 prices. The delay is of the order of thirteen years. Cour des Comptes expressly adds construction cost, inflation and intercalary interest. That is the same distinction of overnight and the cost of money. It is not LCOE. It is a report of one court of audit on one reactor, not a prediction for Dukovany. [12] Vogtle 3 and 4 in the USA began around 14 billion USD with a 2017 date. The final account in an Associated Press estimate moves around 35 billion USD , including settlement after the departure of Westinghouse. Two units, delay of the order of years, the account on the bills of customers in Georgia. Again a capital account, not an LCOE table. [13] In the same interview Havlíček mentioned Flamanville as a warning. There too “cost overrun” is composed of concrete, time and interest. Anyone who makes from that a single lesson “nuclear always costs seven times more” merges three objects and on top of that another country, another technology and another licensing regime. [6] [12] KHNP’s experience from Barakah in the United Arab Emirates is a relevant input into an estimate of the schedule, not proof of a date for Dukovany. The European licensing environment, EUR standards and Czech SÚJB oversight form a different regime. A supplier’s reputation may affect a risk estimate; it cannot replace Czech milestones, permits or ongoing construction control. [15] [17] Before comparison with Dukovany Write down for a foreign project the same as for the Czech one: overnight, interest, the LCOE unit, the price year. If a source adds everything into one “total cost”, you are not comparing Dukovany. You are comparing a foreign sum with a Czech headline. 14. Where to verify the individual accounts Before publication of the contract a reader had to check whether 400 billion was not merely an offer. With the contract he checks something more complicated: whether 407 is overnight, whether escalation is readable, whether 600–700 adds interest or a new EPC, and whether 90 euros is already about something else. A headline is navigation to an account. It is not an automatic account. One report can combine three true numbers into a false conclusion. The first is 407 in 2023 prices. The second is 700 with interest. The third is 90 euros in 2024 prices. Each works. The synthesis “it has become more expensive to 90 euros” is methodologically wrong. At other times a source uses a quality secondary text even though the register of contracts is available. Or it quotes a press conference that in the meantime spoke about a different object. A four-step check of a number Existence: the amount is in a named document, not only in a headline. Object: overnight, escalation, cost of money, or LCOE. Support: a concrete passage supports a concrete sentence. Scope: the number of units, the price year, the payer and what is missing from the number fit. Before a headline about price a table of amounts, their accounting meaning and the limits of the sources should arise. An unavailable or blacked-out basis cannot be replaced by a round estimate in a press statement. 15. The price of steel is the price of a raw material, not the price of a megawatt-hour The market uses several price languages at once. The supplier speaks overnight. The minister speaks about the cost of money. The prime minister speaks about euros per megawatt-hour. ČEPS speaks about the tariff. A direct comparison without knowledge of the object therefore misleads. Cheaper overnight may be fiscally expensive if construction lasts five years longer and interest flows. Dearer overnight may be cheaper in LCOE if the unit starts on time and CfD holds. A cheap headline sum may be expensive if the grid has disappeared from it. An expensive interval of 600–700 may be more honest if it admits interest — and still says nothing about the bill. The real price of an accepted megawatt Overnight EPC + escalation + cost of money + foreign payers, and separately LCOE from production, life and discount. The result is cheap only when the unit runs and the unit price passes scrutiny. Into the costs also belongs fluctuation of the date. If commissioning shifts, the average cost of money is not the price of one year. If contract data are blacked out, the impossibility of an audit is also a cost. It is therefore useful to measure the price of an accepted megawatt on the grid , not the price of a press conference. Accepted means that the unit produces, interest has stopped piling onto construction and CfD is calculated from actual production. This metric may reverse a ranking that looked unambiguous from the overnight price list. It is still not the same as 407, nor the same as 700. 16. What to read for which question Scrutiny of a cost claim begins by determining the account, the price year and the unit. The table shows the first document that makes sense to open for each type of question. Question First object Decisive test Unacceptable shortcut Who won the tender? Overnight offer / EPC The same number of units, price year Mix KHNP with EDF without options Has the contract become more expensive? The same overnight over time 407 → a new EPC, not 400 → 700 Add interest and shout fraud How much will it cost the state? Cost of money + guarantees An MoF or SAO model, not a quotation Take 600–700 as an audit What will be on the bill? LCOE + CfD Unit EUR/MWh, strike, date Divide 407 billion without production How much does the grid cost? ČEPS plan A separate payer Add it to KHNP Will 2036 be met? Schedule and licences SÚJB milestones, not reputation from Barakah “The Koreans can do it, so they will make it” For Czech use a separate language test is necessary. English “cost of nuclear” in an IEA report is not the same as “the price of Dukovany” in a press release. “Interest-free assistance during construction” is not a zero cost of capital. The test set should contain the price year, the number of units, overnight versus interest versus LCOE — and the sentence “the source is insufficient” if the contract is blacked out. Some debates need several numbers at once. That is not a failure. It is the same decision as using a different indicator for GDP and a different one for debt in koruna. The condition is that people know where the authority of the object arises. 17. A short test that says more than a duel of headlines The choice of a number to quote can be made without a six-month tender and without an impulse. A short, disciplined procedure is enough. Its aim is not to prove that a candidate for a headline can do something impressive. The aim is to find a substitution of objects. Seven steps from impression to sentence Write down the object: overnight, escalation, cost of money, foreign payer, or LCOE. Write down the unit: bn Kč, or EUR/MWh. Write down the price year and the number of units. Write down the author: contract, government, minister, IEA, court of audit. Write down what is not in the number. Compare only the same object over time. Separate CfD from EPC. If a sentence contains both, they are two sentences. Three tests of a public number The first is lexical: does the speaker say overnight, financing, or LCOE? The second is temporal: in prices of which year? The third is of scope: two units, or also the option, the grid and fuel? A number that does not pass these three questions is not a lie. It is a map without a legend. The conditions must be comparable. If one text may add interest and another may not, we are testing finished narratives — which may be right, but we must name it. If we want to test overnight, we must conversely exclude interest and LCOE. The pilot should also have an elimination condition. For example: a single sentence that turns 407 into 90 euros without production. High intelligibility must not override a substitution whose impact the debate cannot bear. The last output is not the name of a winner between 400 and 700. It is a rule: which number for what, which not, what must remain in the legend and when the decision is opened again. Contracts, rates and dates change. Without a revision date even a good overnight gradually turns into a superstition. 18. Time as a separate cost item The first generation of communication sold the price of a unit. The next sold suppliers. Today’s dispute sells something larger: the right to a single number. Whoever controls the headline controls the impression of whether it is salvation or a tunnel. The contest is therefore not only for the best overnight. The contest is over which object will be taken as the “real price”. The more comfortable the shortcut that arises, the higher the price of the error. The journalist stops distinguishing EPC and interest. The minister stops distinguishing an estimate and an audit. The reader stops distinguishing billions and euros per megawatt-hour. That does not mean that communicating 400 billion was forbidden. Overnight is a legitimate metric. It means that it should be read consciously. The public needs a portable legend: what the number contains, in which prices, who calculated it and when it will be opened again. Time in this project is a cost variable just as material is. Longer construction may raise financing and change LCOE. KHNP’s experience is an input into an assessment of the schedule, not proof of a future result; licensing, court disputes and grid connection may affect the schedule, but their direction and extent cannot be precisely quantified today. The headlines “400”, “700” and “90 euros” themselves do not resolve this uncertainty. The best number is therefore not the one that never angers. We do not have such a number for a fifteen-year construction. Nor is it the number with the lowest title, the shortest interval or the largest number of zeros. It is a number whose object corresponds to the question posed and whose limits are visible, comparable and economically bearable . At the moment when we ask only “how much does it cost”, we are choosing a headline. At the moment when we read the contract, the loan and the unit price separately, we are choosing a structure of responsibility. And then the question is no longer: “Which number is the truth?” The key is to distinguish overnight, the cost of money and LCOE — and with each number to state who will bear the price of time. — Jiný Kontext

items.title: An exemption from the register may hide a contract. The financial risk does not vanish
items.subtitle: In August 2026 a proposed exemption from the register of contracts for some contracts relating to new nuclear units was described in public. Without verification of the final wording of the amendment, the full scope of the exemption cannot be determined. Failure to publish a contract would not, however, by itself remove financial obligations or the need for substitute public scrutiny.

items.body: An exemption from the register of contracts may protect sensitive technical information, but it can at the same time weaken the public trail of price, guarantees and amendments. A contract that is in force need not be publicly readable, and a blacked-out version need not allow the escalation formula to be checked. Commercial secrecy, legal effect and oversight of public money must therefore be assessed separately. What we know / What we do not know What we know: The register of contracts act in force links, for contracts within its scope, publication with legal effect, and at the same time allows protected data to be rendered unreadable. The public version of the Dukovany EPC contract already contains blacked-out passages. What we do not know: Without the final text and the course of the legislative process it is not possible to claim which contracts and metadata will in fact be exempted, nor what substitute scrutiny will remain for the public. 1. The investor’s certainty is not the taxpayer’s certainty Imagine a meeting on the low-carbon energy act amendment. The ministry of industry and trade lawyer wants an exemption from the register of contracts, because the investor needs certainty that sensitive annexes will not end up in a competitor’s lawsuit. The manager of Elektrárna Dukovany II shows that part of the EPC contract is already in the register and that unit prices are blacked out. The European Commission official recalls that the state-aid notification is running in a non-public file. An opposition MP asks to see the escalation clauses before they feed into the electricity price. A journalist opens smlouvy.gov.cz and hits black bars. The SAI auditor says the file will reach him after the fact. At first glance this is a dispute about secrecy. In reality each person is describing a different problem. The ministry lawyer compares the risk of know-how leaking. The project manager integration with the supplier. The Commission official compatibility with state-aid rules. The MP the ability to scrutinise the executive. The journalist timeliness. The auditor powers, not publicity. The investor’s demand for legal certainty and the public’s demand for scrutiny do not overlap automatically. A legislative solution must describe separately the protection of technology, the risk of disputes, the predictability of return, the visibility of guarantees, access for oversight institutions, and the ability to correct a faulty amendment before it feeds into the tariff. The first important distinction is therefore not whether to build Dukovany. It is what exactly is to be the subject of secrecy . Otherwise we place a reactor drawing, an escalation formula, a state loan and a contract for difference side by side and are surprised that each needs a different regime. A contract is not a guarantee. A guarantee is not a tariff. A tariff is not public debt. And an exemption from the register is not the disappearance of risk. — Jiný Kontext From a valid contract to the tariff An illustrative chain between legal effect, price, publication and later changes. From a valid contract to the tariff Validity Price Register Amendments Tariff JINÝ KONTEXT Illustrative diagram: The chain shows points of scrutiny; it does not rate a particular exemption or unpack any contract. 2. What the public scrutinises in a contractual regime When a PDF appears — or does not appear — on a website, it is easy to form the impression that “the state published the contract” or “the state hid it”. The result, however, usually arises in a chain of several layers. Each can increase scrutiny, reduce it, or change the type of error. Two documents with the same title therefore need not say the same thing, and the same document may behave differently according to whether it is in the register, blacked out, withdrawn, or only in a vault. Five layers of one contract Existence and effect: whether the obligation is binding between the parties even if the public cannot see it. Price and risk content: who bears extra costs, delay, inflation and a change of exchange rate. Publication regime: a full PDF, redaction under the register act, or an exemption. Amendments and options: changes that can move price and time without a new headline in the papers. State aid and the tariff: a state loan, a balancing payment and the pass-through into the electricity price. The basic contract text determines an important part of the relationships, but it is not the only actor. An explanatory memorandum can insert a different purpose before the text. An amendment can change escalation. Notification to the Commission can see the contract without the citizen seeing it. The regulator can calculate the tariff from a figure that is not in the register. A company lawyer can label the same formula as a trade secret, while an MP labels it as public debt. This is precisely where the first error of public comparisons arises. A headline announces a contest of “transparency versus security”, but in reality it compares a drawing with a price formula, or an EPC contract with a contract for difference. An honest comparison must state not only the name of the act, but also the type of contract, whether it has already been published, what of it can be blacked out under the existing rules, and who else will still see the file. This layering is not an academic detail. It determines where to turn when something fails. If the public does not know yesterday’s amendment, the register may have been missing. If it overlooked an inflation clause in the middle of an annex, redaction may have failed. If the tariff rose and the PDF disappeared, the problem may have been the exemption and the absence of a substitute report. The sentence “the contract is secret” is the beginning of a diagnosis, not its end. Illustrative diagram: The same project can, in a different publication regime, with different amendments and a different notification, create different scrutiny. 3. The best regime is the one whose error you will see Minimising the leak of know-how is a legitimate aim, but a publication regime must also be judged by how detectable and correctable an error is. The leak of a technical drawing can cause a different kind of damage from an invisible escalation clause that later appears in the price. With a partly published document a review of the scope of redaction can be requested; with a complete exemption no public trail of scrutiny arises. The Constitutional Court, in judgment Pl. ÚS 32/17 of 22 January 2019, dismissed a proposal to repeal the register of contracts act. The aim of the act, according to the court, is the publication of selected contracts in which at least one party is an entity tied to public funds, and thereby also a scrutiny function under the right to information and the right to take part in the administration of public affairs. The court at the same time recalled that a trade secret can be protected inside the existing act. This is a judgment on the constitutionality of the register as a whole, not a verdict on a specific amendment from 2026. [11] Type of failure What it looks like How to test it What limits the harm Leak of know-how A drawing, a process, a unit margin in an open PDF Separate the technical annex from the price formula Redaction, not an exemption of the whole title Invisible escalation An amendment changes the price, the public does not see it A mandatory summary of changes to price and time Periodicity of a report, even if the PDF is missing Loss of trail Withdrawal of a record already published Whether legal effect survives inaccessibility An archival imprint, a ban on silent deletion Substitution of the overseer “The Commission can see it” is read as “the citizen can see it” Who has the file, when, and what may be said outside A mandate for parliament and the SAI in real time This also changes the legislative question. We do not ask only which regime better protects the supplier. We ask which regime will fail in a way that our process will catch. A supplier may tolerate the public not seeing a welding procedure. A taxpayer cannot tolerate the same regime hiding who pays for delay. An MP may accept redaction if the net risk formula is visible. He cannot accept withdrawal of the whole title without a substitute. Alongside the protection of technology it is necessary to measure the traceability of money, the possibility of reviewing a change, and its impact on the tariff. A regime with precisely delimited redaction and a public summary of guarantees may preserve more scrutiny than a complete exemption; the specific scope, however, must be set by statute. 4. What the register shows and what it does not The register of contracts is needed because it replaces part of impressions with repeatable publication. Act No. 340/2015 Coll. makes the effect of selected private-law contracts depend on publication. At the same time it allows information that cannot be provided under the rules on free access to information, including trade secrets, not to be published. That is a map of the duty. It is not a verdict that Dukovany is advantageous, nor a verdict that it is disadvantageous. [1] Redakční ilustrace · Jiný Kontext Every exemption contains hidden decisions. Which types of contract? Only EPC, or also offtake, the balancing regime and the loan? May a record already published be made inaccessible? Does it apply to amendments? To the option for Temelín? To fuel? An answer to any of these questions can change what the citizen still sees. Five facts without which an “exemption for certainty” is only an advertising sentence An exact list of contracts and amendments to which the regime applies. Whether the condition of effect upon publication is cancelled, or only visibility. Whether an already published record can be withdrawn without loss of effect. Who else sees the file, at what time and with what reporting duty. How a change of price and time reaches the public when the PDF disappears. For the legislator, therefore, a small list of objects matters more than the broad word “strategic”. Thirty real clauses — with a real effect on the tariff, a Czech text and a clear bearer of risk — may say more than a reference to “the practice of the European Commission” without citation of a specific requirement of secrecy. A public register will help select what can be blacked out. The decision on an exemption must do the work with a list. Publication has blind spots PDF, redaction, exemption and other auditors surround the same contract. Publication has blind spots PDF Redaction Exemption SAI Contract JINÝ KONTEXT Interpretive diagram: Elements do not express a transparency score; they only name what remains visible and what does not. 5. Compare certainties, not logos The scheme divides demands according to whether they protect technology, the investor’s legal position, public scrutiny of price, or the powers of an oversight body. Each certainty has a different proof and a different typical failure. Actor Main certainty What to verify in the amendment Typical reason for the choice Investor / supplier Protection of margin, know-how, fewer lawsuits What exactly cannot be blacked out under the existing rules Lower procedural risk MIT Alignment with the support model and the notification Whether the Commission requires secrecy of the register, or merely tolerates it Speed of closing European Commission Proportionality of aid, less distortion of the market The public version of the decision vs. the confidential file Supervision of state aid Taxpayer Who pays extra costs and delay Visibility of the formula, not visibility of the logo The bill in the household statement Parliament / SAI Timely access and a report Whether access comes before the tariff, or after it Scrutiny of the executive The rows are not a judgment on the project. The same state offers more than one contract, and each may change during construction by an amendment. The map is meant to prevent a different error: that the legislator buys excellent protection of technology in a regime that cannot see his bill, cannot show it in time, or locks it into an environment from which it is later hard to leave. How to read the scheme: The position of the elements does not express a score. The diagram separates protection of sensitive information from scrutiny of price, guarantees and amendments. 6. Legal effect is not the same as visibility The register of contracts act stood on a simple lever: a selected contract of a public contracting authority takes effect upon publication. The point was not to harass officials. It was to create a universal trail. If a state enterprise or a ministry signs a multi-billion contract, the public should see at least the parties, the subject, the price where it is not a secret, and the existence of amendments. [1] An exemption from the register does not mean the disappearance of the contract. It means that the condition under which the contract lives in public space is changing. The citizen loses the position of overseer in real time. He becomes the payer of a future bill whose items he will see later, elsewhere, or not at all. Rekonstrukce státu and Frank Bold defended this lever mechanism also in the dispute over exemptions for state firms: the register is a tool, not a duplicate of the free-access-to-information act. That is an institutional reading. It is not proof that every Dukovany annex must hang open. [12] [13] The existing act already knows how to black out. The Constitutional Court expressly took that into account in 2019. The dispute of 2026 is therefore not about whether a secret may exist. It is about whether the existence of some titles should disappear as well, and whether records that the public has already seen once should be allowed to be withdrawn. That is more important than a dispute about the word “transparency”. A blacked-out contract in the register still says: this amendment exists, this date applies, this party signed. A withdrawn or never-published title says nothing. Scrutiny moves from remote access to a request, a security clearance, a mandate or chance. 7. Anatomy of the proposed exemption: what is to leave the register In August 2026 a draft amendment to Act No. 367/2021 Coll., on measures for the transition to low-carbon energy, and related rules, was described in public. The cited materials do not, however, contain in this article a verified final version from eKLEP or the outcome of the legislative process. The further description is therefore a summary of public specialist reporting, not a claim about law already in force. [2] [3] According to this public description the exemption is to aim, among other things, at: contracts on the offtake of electricity and the contract on the balancing regime, that is an analogue of a two-way contract for difference (CfD); contracts on the provision of repayable financial assistance, that is the terms of the state loan for construction; a publicly mentioned possibility of making some already published documents and amendments inaccessible without their losing effect; the exact scope must be confirmed by the final wording of the draft. The draft is to introduce a balancing regime as the basic support model, while the offtake contract is to remain an alternative if the government sets it by resolution. The ministry justifies this by the Commission’s decision-making practice, which prefers a balancing regime. This is a reading of the explanatory memorandum and reporting on eKLEP, not a citation of a Commission decision that the register of contracts must be switched off. [2] [3] The difference between “black out the unit price” and “do not insert the title” is practical. In the first regime the citizen sees that amendment No. 4 exists, even if he does not see every cell. In the second he does not even see that the amendment arose. The dispute is therefore not about the protection of detailed drawings. It is about the trail of the financial formulae according to which the taxpayer’s bill may change. What needs to be tested The first test concerns the list. Which specific types of contract does the amendment exempt, and which does it leave in the register? The second concerns retrospective inaccessibility: whether a record that was already public can be withdrawn, and whether that implies a loss of effect, or only a loss of eyes. The third concerns the Commission: where is the sentence that a public register endangers the notification, and where it is the ministry’s preference. Without these three supports, “alignment with Brussels” is a broad word. For the project, integration of contracts may be decisive. For the legislator, however, the sentence “we are protecting the investor” is not enough. He needs to know the type of title, the owner of the data, permitted withdrawal, export of a summary, and the boundary beyond which a person with a mandate must approve the change. What is visible and what stays opaque are not the same A public PDF and a hidden formula belong to different kinds of scrutiny. What is visible and what stays opaque are not the same Public Opaque PDF Register Formula Amendment Trail JINÝ KONTEXT Interpretive diagram: The sides are not a secrecy ratio; they separate publication from what remains unreadable. 8. Redaction is not the same as deletion Elektrárna Dukovany II published in the register of contracts the EPC contract with KHNP and the fuel contract. Government and company communication after the signing on 4 June 2025 stated a price of two units of CZK 407 billion at the 2023 price level and a unit price per block in the order of CZK 200 billion. The fuel contract was communicated separately, in the order of CZK 15 billion. These are prices of the works at the given price level, not the sum of interest, the grid, preparation and future escalation. A large part of the published PDF is blacked out: according to the contracting authority because of security, intellectual property and copyright, including passages on price, completion and subcontracting. [4] [5] [6] This is a regime that the existing act knows. The public sees that the title exists, even if it does not see every cell. If a future exemption also covered metadata without a substitute public overview, this trail could disappear from the register; other scrutiny channels would not automatically vanish thereby. The scope cannot be claimed categorically without the final text of the amendment. Imagine an amendment. It is not a report. It is an illustration of the mechanism. In 2026 the state announces a unit price per block in the order of CZK 200 billion and takes the contracts and amendments out of the register. In 2031 the supplier applies a non-public escalation clause in amendment No. 4. The price of the block rises by tens of billions. The taxpayer learns of it at the moment when the regulator feeds a higher guaranteed price into the component. Retrospective scrutiny of whether it was justified is, for a person without a mandate, legally and factually different from a record that hangs in the register at least as a blacked-out PDF with a date. It does not follow that escalation is fraud. It follows that the place of scrutiny has shifted. Redaction changes what can be read. Deletion changes whether we even know that there is something to read. 9. Dukovany II: where know-how ends and the bill begins The project of two new units at Dukovany belongs in scale among the largest publicly supported investments in the modern history of Czechia. We do not document here an exact ranking among historical contracts. Large scale itself does not justify an arbitrary regime; it does, however, raise the price of a possible error in oversight. Redakční ilustrace · Jiný Kontext The dispute about the register often poses as a dispute about nuclear safety. SÚJB, however, oversees the licence, not whether the CfD formula is in the PDF. Safety supervision and financial supervision are not the same. A technical drawing belongs in a different vault from a clause that says who pays for delay in concrete. If the amendment wraps both in the word “strategic”, it compares a reactor with an accounting table. International LCOE models, for example publications of the IEA and OECD NEA, show the sensitivity of nuclear economics to construction time and the cost of capital. This is not an audit of Dukovany, and from these studies it cannot be proved that time escalation will always be more expensive than secrecy of a technical annex. The practical question is narrower: whether the public regime will show in time who bears the costs of delay. [16] The option for further units, mentioned at the signing, extends the trail beyond one site. An exemption written for “key contracts for new nuclear sources” is therefore not to be read only as Dukovany. It is to be read as a template. A template is useful if it is narrow. It is expensive if it is broad. 10. The contract for difference and the state loan: the raw material is not the result The market uses several price languages at once. EPC is the price of the works at a price level. Interest is the price of time. A CfD or a balancing regime is the price of stability of return. Repayable financial assistance is the price of public capital. The tariff is what the household finally sees. A direct comparison of “a contract for 407 billion” without these columns misleads. Cheap secrecy of an annex can be economically excellent if it prevents supplier speculation. The same secrecy can be expensive for a clause that the taxpayer will pay for twenty years. Expensive publicity of every page can be unnecessary for a welding procedure. It can be cheaper for a formula that reduces the number of later disputes about “what they promised”. The true price of the accepted regime Licence and safety + EPC + fuel + grid + interest + balancing payment + human scrutiny of amendments + the price of invisible escalation + a future precedent. The result is cheap only when it passes the check of the bearer of risk and can be used in the tariff. Not when it disappears from search. The Commission, in Decision (EU) 2025/429 of 30 April 2024, assessed support for the construction and operation of a new unit at Dukovany (SA.58207) among other things so that the aid would not exceed the funding gap and would not distort the market more than necessary. The original notification concerned one unit. The extension to two units and a change of the investor model led to further assessment. In December 2025 the Commission opened an in-depth investigation into support for two units (SA.117794). This is supervision of state aid, not an order to switch off the Czech register. [7] [8] It is therefore useful to measure the price by accepted oversight , not by the number of blacked-out pages. Accepted means that a change of price and of the bearer of risk is visible in time, even if the drawing is not. This metric can reverse an order that looked unambiguous for the reason “investor certainty”. 11. The European Commission sees the file. The taxpayer does not Supporters of the amendment often join two sentences: the Commission sees the contracts, therefore scrutiny exists. That is reasonable, but incomplete. The Commission sees what is the subject of the notification, in a confidential regime, with a different purpose and a different time. The purpose is compatibility of aid with the internal market. The purpose is not ongoing civic scrutiny of amendments. The decision is published in a non-confidential version. Annexes remain in the vault. Two similar files can therefore have a different data regime. Notification SA.58207 approved support for one unit under set conditions, including a shortening of the period of direct price support and a formula close to a two-way CfD. Investigation SA.117794 asks among other things whether the aid package is superfluous and whether risk is being shifted onto the state. That is a European map. It is not the Czech register. [7] [8] Two similar bills can have a different regime of eyes An official in Brussels may read a confidential file and may not turn it into an information sheet for a household. An MP in Prague may want an information sheet and need not receive the file. A taxpayer may want both and will receive a tariff. If the amendment says that “scrutiny remains because the Commission can see it”, we are testing a different product from the one the sentence promises. It may be correct as a notification. We must name it that way. The Czech ministry may have a good reason to align the balancing regime with Commission practice. It does not follow that alignment requires silence in the register. It follows that it is necessary to show the sentence where the Commission forbids publicity, and the sentence where the ministry merely does not want publicity. 12. The SAI, SÚJB and the Chamber have different mandates Before the exemption the citizen checked whether the contract was hanging. With the exemption he checks something more complicated: whether the SAI received the amendment in time, whether a Chamber committee saw the formula, whether SÚJB happens to be watching something else, and whether the summary the public receives really supports the sentence about “full scrutiny”. Citation of an office is navigation to a mandate. It is not an automatic mandate for publicity. SÚJB oversees nuclear safety and licensing. The SAI checks management within the scope of its statutory competence and according to its audit plan; it is not continuous public scrutiny of every amendment. The European Commission assesses state aid. These mandates overlap with the register of contracts only in part and do not themselves offer the public the same ongoing remote access. [9] [10] Four-step check of substitute oversight Existence: the body really has the file, not only competence on paper. Time: it sees the amendment before it enters the tariff. Support: the report to the public supports a specific sentence about price and risk. Scope: the unit, the period, the currency and what remained confidential all fit. The most reliable procedure therefore separates safety, aid and money. First a table arises: who sees the drawing, who sees the CfD, who sees the loan, who sees amendment No. 4. Only then the sentence “scrutiny remains”. If the body cannot say outside at least the change in the overall guarantee, the claim is not promoted to publicity merely because the office exists. Three tests of substitute scrutiny The first is temporal: when does the body receive the file and when does the tariff change? The second is about origin: is it the full text, or a summary written by a party to the contract? The third is about contradiction: is there a credible channel that challenges the conclusion of “zero risk for the state”? A product that announces the exemption a week earlier need not be better if in five years nobody can find out why the bill rose just so. 13. The privacy of a contract is not a switch. It is the whole flow of amendments The question “is it trained on my data?” sounds narrow in another field. Here the question “is it a trade secret?” sounds narrow. An organisation must also know where amendments are stored, for how long, who has access to them, whether records of withdrawal from the register are kept, which third parties see balancing payments, and whether an agent on the supplier’s side sends a price change to the next link in the chain. “We do not publish in the register” does not mean “nothing is retained” nor “nobody will see anything”. Redakční ilustrace · Jiný Kontext The differences between consumer curiosity and a parliamentary mandate are marked in the law. It does not follow that every contract belongs on the internet in full wording. It follows that the security of know-how cannot be judged by the project logo without a list of titles, withdrawals and a substitute report. The practical minimum is a flow map. It begins at signature, continues with registration or exemption, amendments, notification, tariff regulation, and ends at the place where a price change can still be reversed. Without this map a claim of certainty is only a description of one part of the pipe. Act No. 367/2021 Coll. already today regulates support for low-carbon sources and shareholder relations with Elektrárna Dukovany II. An amendment that inserts the silence of the register into it therefore does not change only one paragraph on publication. It changes the path along which information will flow about the support that the same act organises. [15] 14. What to choose as a scrutiny regime Legislative scrutiny should not begin with a choice between “open everything” and “close everything”, but with classification of the specific information and designation of the entitled overseer. The table proposes what to compare on the same document, at the same time and with the same bearer of risk. Need First regime Decisive test Unacceptable shortcut Protection of technology Redaction of annexes under the existing act Whether the § on secrecy suffices, or deletion of the title is necessary Exempt the whole contract because of a drawing See the existence of amendments A record in the register even with black bars Date, parties, subject, a link to the previous version Withdrawal of an already published record without an imprint Watching state aid Notification to the Commission + a public decision What of the confidential file may go out as a summary “Brussels can see it” as a substitute for the register Watching the tariff A mandatory report on a change of formula and cap Whether the report arrives before the component changes Waiting for the regulator’s information sheet Parliamentary oversight Timely committee access to the uncensored text A record that the committee saw amendment No. 4 Competence on paper without a deadline Precedent A narrow list of nuclear titles with a review date Whether the text also fits a motorway and armaments The word “strategic” without a list For Czech use a separate language test is necessary. The English “commercially sensitive” will not measure whether a Czech taxpayer understands that a CfD is not the same as a fixed price on a billboard. The test set should contain EPC, fuel, a loan, a balancing regime, an option and an amendment in which the correct answers are both “this can be blacked out” and “this cannot be exempted”. Some states finally need more than one regime. One for the drawing, a second for money, a third for safety, a fourth for aid. That is not a failure of unity. It is the same decision as using a different vault for fuel and a different one for accounting. The condition is that the division is intelligible, titles do not pass into silence unchecked, and people know where final authority arises. 15. A short test that will say more than an explanatory memorandum The choice of regime can be made without a ten-year dispute about “betrayal of transparency” and without impulsively switching off the register. A short, disciplined legislative pilot is enough. Its aim is not to prove that the investor can sign. The aim is to find situations in which oversight fails, and to see whether the state can catch them. Fourteen days from the word certainty to a list Days 1–2: Write down 20 to 40 real clauses: price, time, escalation, option, fuel, grid, change of law. Days 3–4: Assign to each whether redaction suffices, or whether the amendment demands deletion. Days 5–7: Verify what already hangs in the register, what is black, and what could be withdrawn. Days 8–10: Ask the SAI, committees and the MIT who will see an amendment in what T+ days. Days 11–12: Calculate which change will enter the tariff before a public sentence about it arises. Day 13: Stress tests: delay, inflation, exchange rate, withdrawal of a record, an option for further units. Day 14: Decide according to the matrix, document the reservation and set the date of the next review. If possible the assessor should not know whether he is to approve the exemption. For technology he watches whether redaction suffices. For money, whether a trail remains. For aid, whether the Commission’s public decision carries the sentence that the ministry attributes to secrecy. Each failure is classified: confabulation of a Commission requirement, omission of an amendment, an error of time, or an action that wipes the imprint. Conditions must be comparable. The same title, the same day. If one regime may withdraw a PDF and the other may not, we are testing finished products — but we must name it that way. The pilot should also have elimination conditions. For example: a single silent withdrawal of an already published price, use of the word “Commission” without a citation, or inability to export a summary of a change in guarantees. A high score for “investor certainty” should not override an error whose impact the taxpayer will see only in the household statement. The last output is not only yes or no. It is an operating rule: which title may disappear, which must remain at least as a black PDF, who approves an amendment, how the result is verified and when the exemption is opened again. Support models, notifications and suppliers change. Without a review date even a good reason gradually turns into an energy superstition. 16. An exemption is not a one-off. It is a precedent The first generation of disputes about the register concerned listed state firms. MPs later narrowed part of the exemption for ČEZ and similar entities: contracts outside the main business activity are published. That is a historical map. It is not proof that a nuclear EPC is the same as buying offices. It is proof that an exemption, once written, lives on in analogy. [12] [13] A text that says “key contracts for new nuclear sources” will tomorrow be read for a high-speed line, a motorway PPP and a military acquisition. That may be correct if the list is hard and the review date is firm. It is expensive if the list is soft. A precedent is not a legal opinion. It is a template that another ministry will fill in next time. Retrospective inaccessibility of already published records is especially sensitive in this template. It changes the expectation: what once hung can disappear without effect disappearing. That is a different product from “from now on we will not publish new contracts”. It tests trust in the archive, not only trust in the supplier. The exemption should therefore be bought consciously. We need a narrow list of titles, a ban on silent withdrawal without an imprint, a documented interface for parliament, and an emergency procedure when the tariff rises and the PDF is missing. 17. What the public loses when the trail of amendments disappears The first generation of the register sold publication as a condition of validity. The next generation sold redaction. Today’s amendment sells something larger: a place in which the state negotiates, changes and hides the working context of the largest contract, and from which the public signs off. The contest is therefore not only about the best protection of know-how. It is about who holds the memory of amendments. The more comfortable the silence, the higher the price of a return to publicity can be. Amendments are hard to reconstruct, tariff automata rely on a figure nobody has seen, and people stop distinguishing a legitimate secret from a missing trail. That does not mean that secrecy of a drawing is bad. Precisely that often creates the greatest benefit. It means that it should be bought consciously. The state needs a portable summary of risks, a documented interface, the ability to change the supplier of information — that is at least a report, if not already a PDF — and a regular test of whether the original reason for the exemption still holds. The best regime is therefore not the one that never shows anything. Such a regime the taxpayer will not bear. Nor is it the regime with the longest PDF, the highest number of black bars or the largest reference to the Commission. It is the regime whose silence matches the technology and whose money is visible, reversible and bearable in the tariff . The moment the contract only describes a weld, we choose protection of know-how. The moment it reads a state loan, a balancing payment, an amendment and a future component, we also choose a new structure of responsibility. And then the question is no longer: “Does the investor have a right to a secret?” What decides is which change the public will see in time, who can review it, and who will bear the price when a non-public clause feeds into the bill. — Jiný Kontext

items.title: When an algorithm decides on a loan: accuracy is not the same as fairness
items.subtitle: Credit scoring can speed up and sharpen an estimate of risk, but the outcome depends on the data, the objective, the threshold and human review. Proxy variables can create differences between groups; public sources do not, however, show that every Czech bank uses them, nor that automation always outperforms a person.
