items.body: A familiar voice on the phone is no longer reliable proof of identity. A synthetic recording can sound faithful, while a detector that succeeds on laboratory files fails after the signal has passed through a particular telephone codec. Defence therefore has to work with the payment process and a second verification channel, not with hearing alone. What we know / What we do not know What we know: A synthetic voice can sound convincing, and the voice channel itself does not confirm the caller’s identity. The risk can be reduced by an agreed procedure, a callback to a known number, and a second approval of the payment. What we do not know: There is no universal sample length, and no detector reliability that holds for every model, language and telephone channel. From the sound alone, without more evidence, one also cannot determine the legal qualification of a particular case. 1. A voice that is no longer a seal of identity Picture the Monday meeting after an incident. The director wants a new detector, because “AI can do everything now”. IT proposes a ban on voice messages. Finance insists on a second channel for every payment above a set amount. The lawyer cites the AI Act and the Criminal Code. Communications wants training. The assistant who sent the money wants to know how she was supposed to recognise a voice that sounded exactly like the boss. At first glance this is a dispute about technology. In fact each person is describing a different problem. The director compares hearing and the model. IT describes the attack surface. Finance describes whether the payment can be reversed. The lawyer describes penalties after the act. Communications describes habit. The assistant describes the cost of a mistake in ten seconds. A detector can label the sound correctly and still fail to stop the money from being sent. A security design therefore separates the channel, the amount threshold, a password agreed in advance, approval by a second person, an audit trail, and the ability to stop the payment. A comparison of vocoders is only a partial test. For a real fraud one has to evaluate, separately, the quality of the sound, human recognition, technical detection, identity verification, and the approval rule for the payment. A voice is not an identity. Fidelity is not origin. A detector is not a lock. And the law after the money has been sent is not a defence. — Jiný Kontext 2. What a fraudulent call is made of When a familiar voice comes out of the telephone, it is easy to form the impression that “he is the one calling”. But the result usually arises in a chain. Each layer can raise the quality of the attack, lower it, or change the type of error. Two frauds that use the same clone therefore need not end the same way, and the same clone can behave differently according to the channel, the pressure, and whether a second step exists. Five layers of one emergency call Raw material: a public video, a voice message, a podcast, a “sorry, wrong number”. Synthesis: a model that builds a new sentence from a short sample. Channel: a call, a voice message, a video conference, a robocall. Script: distress, authority, time pressure, a non-standard account. Control: a password, a callback, a payment threshold, a rollback. The base model determines an important part of the fidelity, but it is not the only actor. An attacker can insert an SMS before the call, send an account number after the call, cut off the chance to ask a question, or wait until the victim is alone. The same voice in a calm conversation and in “five minutes until they detain him” is not the same exercise. This is where the first error of the public debate is born. A headline announces a contest between the ear and AI, but in fact it compares two different chains: laboratory listening with a warning, and a telephone in the kitchen without one. Or, conversely, it measures that a detector hit a dataset and then presents the result as a verdict on a family payment. An honest comparison has to state not only the name of the model, but also the channel, the codec, the presence of pressure, the time available, and the method of control. Without a cut through the layers, the call becomes magic. That cut determines where to turn when something fails. If the voice sounded right but the account number was new, the channel failed. If no password existed, administration failed. If the detector stayed silent on GSM, the transmission layer failed. The sentence “AI deceived us” is the beginning of a diagnosis, not its end. Illustrative scheme: The same clone can, in another channel, under another pressure and with another payment threshold, produce a different harm. 3. The best defence is the one whose error you can bear In detection, what matters is not only the success rate, but also the consequence of a false alarm and of a forgery that was missed. A wrongly flagged family recording has a different impact from a transfer to a fraudster’s account. The process therefore has to be stricter where the decision is hard to reverse. In its generative-AI risk profile, NIST points to erroneous content that is presented convincingly, and to the fact that risk does not grow only with the frequency of error. It also grows when the form tempts disproportionate trust. [17] Type of failure What it looks like How to test it What limits the harm Faithful clone The voice fits; the sentence is new A practice call with an agreed password A second channel; a ban on paying on voice alone Pressure “Right now, otherwise…” Whether the protocol can say no A time lock; an amount threshold Channel An account in an SMS, a new contact, a video call Whether the number is in the directory A callback to a stored number False detection The detector stays silent, or else shouts all the time A dataset versus a real codec A process, not a single score That also changes the question we are asking. We are not asking only which system will recognise a forgery on average. We are asking which one will fail in a way that our process can catch. A family can tolerate ten false suspicions, because it can bear one delayed call. An accounts department cannot tolerate a single hidden change of account number. A developer can accept a false alarm if a payment test fails. A mother on the telephone must not mistake fluency of voice for identity. Human listening is only one control. It also matters to record the request, to limit payment authority, and to require a second approval. Such a process can be more resilient than even the laboratory’s best detector on its own. 4. What laboratory 73 percent means Detection tests are needed, because they replace part of impression with a repeatable trial. The problem begins at the moment when one score starts to stand for a person’s entire ability. In 2023, in PLOS ONE , Mai, Bray, Davies and Griffin presented genuine and synthetic recordings to 529 listeners in English and Mandarin and asked them to mark the fakes. Listeners identified the deepfake in 73 percent of cases. There was no difference between the languages. A short familiarisation with examples improved the result only slightly. This is a laboratory task in which people knew they were looking for fakes and listened to samples one sentence long. It is not evidence of behaviour on an unexpected telephone call. It does show, however, that even under favourable conditions hearing is not enough for a reliable defence. [6] Every test contains hidden decisions. Did the listeners know it was a test? Was it a telephone, or a clean recording? Which codec? Which model? How many seconds? Is identity being judged, or only whether “it sounds artificial”? An answer to any of these questions can change the number. Newer commercial clones may be harder; older synthesis easier. The authors themselves note that the algorithms used were already not the latest at the time. Five facts without which 73 percent is only an advertising number The exact synthesizer version and the language of the samples. Whether people were warned that deepfakes would be present. The length of the recording, the channel and the compression. Whether naturalness is being judged, or a match of identity. The sample size and the interval of uncertainty. For buying a defence, a small internal test is therefore more important than someone else’s overall ranking. Thirty real company scenarios — with a real payment threshold, the Czech language, a telephone codec and real time pressure — can say more than a thousand laboratory sentences. A public test helps to select candidates. The decision has to be made by the protocol. Telephone networks cut the band and compress the signal, which can weaken some detection marks, reshape others, and at the same time add new artefacts. Without a test of the particular codec one cannot claim that compression of a track generally “erases” it. Listening on a call is therefore not the same task as listening to a clean file in a study. 5. Compare channels, not vocoders The diagram splits the attack by voice source, channel, time pressure and the target decision. Defenders can then test a particular point of failure instead of a general ranking of generators. Channel Main operating stance What to check in the exercise Typical reason the attacker chooses it Voice message One-way pressure; no chance to ask back Whether the protocol forbids paying from a voice message Live synthesis is not needed Telephone call A familiar number, or spoofing A callback to a stored number Distress and interruption Video call The authority of a group; several faces A second channel, a password, a delay of the payment A company transfer Robocall Scale; political or commercial content The origin of the number, a complaint, an archive Thousands of handsets at once Family emergency Emotion, haste, bail A family password; a ban on an instant transfer The victim already believes the voice The rows are not a judgment on the quality of the models. The same tool offers several modes, and each can change within a few months. The map is meant to prevent another error: that an organisation buys an excellent detector into a process that cannot see the payment, cannot stop it, or locks the decision into hearing from which it is later hard to walk away. How to read the scheme: Neither the position nor the size of the elements expresses a score. The diagram separates an audio forgery, a verification of identity, and an irreversible payment decision. 6. Five seconds of recording: raw material, not a crime Cloning a voice used to require hours of studio recordings. In a survey of the misuse of artificial intelligence, Europol describes tools that, according to their advertising, need only a five-second recording of the target. [1] This is a warning from a security agency and a description of tools that are available, not a laboratory measurement of every model in use today. It does, however, show a threshold: the raw material is short, and often public. Redakční ilustrace · Jiný Kontext A sample can be taken from a voice message, from a video on a network, from a conference, from a podcast, or from a “sorry, wrong number” call. That is not magic. It is the same logic as a password written on a slip of paper: whoever has the raw material has a start. Voice synthesis also has legitimate uses — a voice for patients after loss of speech, accessibility, dubbing with consent. It does not follow that every clone is a crime. It follows that raw material and the act are two layers. A public video is not consent to an emergency message. Five seconds is not fraud. Fraud begins where fidelity is joined to a request that cannot be undone. An illustration, not a report. An attacker downloads ten seconds from a public podcast and makes a voice message for the assistant: a deposit of 180 000 CZK, a notary, an account in an SMS, urgent. The colour fits; a café is in the background. Process control — reverse verification through another channel — is missing. The sound was faithful. Layer five failed. 7. Pressure and channel: the fraud does not begin with the model The success of a fraud depends on psychological manipulation and on time pressure as much as on the fidelity of the AI. That is reasonable to read as a diagnosis, not as an excuse. A model without a script is a demo. A script without a model was already vishing before synthesis. In its report on the state of cybersecurity of the Czech Republic for 2023, NÚKIB ranks phishing and its derivatives — including vishing — among the most common techniques. On vishing it states expressly that the numbers of real organisations, the names of officials, or a voice with the help of AI can be misused. [10] This is a description of threats inside the authority’s incident framework, not an audit of every Czech telephone call. In a campaign on fraudulent telephone calls, the Czech Banking Association stated that for 2023 it recorded almost 70 thousand attacked clients and average damage of more than 19 thousand crowns, with a year-on-year roughly threefold rise in the number of attacks. In the same campaign the Police of the Czech Republic put the figure at almost 200 million CZK lured from accounts, on average more than half a million crowns a day; the highest recorded amount from one victim in Prague was almost 5.5 million CZK. [18] These numbers describe telephone fraud as a whole, not the share that already used a deepfake. They are a map of harm. They are not a verdict on a vocoder. A process that forbids making a payment on a voice request alone can reduce the risk sharply even against a convincing clone. It is not absolute protection: an attacker can hit the second channel, obtain the password, or abuse an internal exception. Hearing by itself is therefore a weaker control than several independent steps. Three tests of an urgent call The first is a test of time: can the request be postponed by twenty minutes? The second is a test of origin: am I calling back the number I have stored, not the number from the call? The third is a test of contradiction: does the password fit, the place, the dog’s name, yesterday’s detail that a clone from a video does not have? A product that “sounds a second more faithful” need not be more dangerous if the protocol forces these three tests. 8. The harm is empirical. It is not science fiction The effects are no longer only laboratory effects. Before the New Hampshire primary in January 2024, thousands of voters received a robocall with a synthetic voice of Joe Biden that urged them not to take part. The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) imposed a civil penalty of 6 million dollars on the organiser. [8] A criminal jury in New Hampshire later acquitted the defendant. That is an important distinction: a civil sanction for spoofing and an AI voice is not the same as a criminal verdict on the suppression of voters. The case shows the scalability of the channel, not that every political call is a deepfake. In January 2024 an employee of the Hong Kong office of Arup, according to reports of the case, authorised transfers in the order of 25 million dollars after a video conference in which synthetic avatars of management appeared. The fraud was revealed only by a check against headquarters, after the money had already gone. [9] This is a reported company incident, not a public court file in this text. The mechanism is still readable: the authority of a group, a live image, several transfers, a check that came too late. The Czech harm from vishing of the 200 million CZK mentioned above for 2023 is an order of magnitude elsewhere and on another channel. A comparison of the USA, Hong Kong and the Czech Republic is therefore not one ranking. It is a map showing that distress, authority and scale work in different fields. The definition of “deepfake” in police statistics need not match the definition in a laboratory paper. When the definition fits badly, it is more honest to say so than to add pears together. 9. A detector is a race. It is not a lock Against a synthetic voice there are tools that look for spectral traces, irregularities in breath, fingerprints of generators. Projects such as vera.ai and work on the frequency analysis of synthetic media describe this line. [2] [4] Pindrop published a forensic view of the New Hampshire robocall. [3] On test sets detectors can score high. That is a property of the dataset, the version of the attack and the threshold. It is not a lock on the handset. Attackers can adapt models and post-processing to known detection marks. Telephone compression can worsen some marks or change them. A false-positive alarm burdens operations, and a false-negative stays silent. The concrete extent of this effect, however, has to be shown by a study or a test of the given detector, generator and channel. The Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA) makes a different bet: not “can you tell that it is fake”, but “can you prove where it is from”. Content Credentials are meant to carry origin, not impression. [5] That does not move the problem into the sky. It moves it to a place where it can be tested: does the file have a signature? Was it broken? Who is the issuer? The largest competitive advantage of a defence therefore need not be a model. It can be order in payments. And the largest weakness need not be a hallucination of the ear. It can be the genuine voice of the boss, who nevertheless never sends an account in an SMS. 10. The law punishes ex post. The money leaves ex ante The duties in Article 50 of the AI Act apply, according to the timetable of the regulation, from 2 August 2026 and distinguish two roles. Under paragraph 2, a provider of a system that generates synthetic content has to ensure machine-readable marking and the detectability of the output to the extent that is technically feasible and with the exceptions stated. Under paragraph 4, a deployer has to disclose that image, audio or video content constituting a deepfake was artificially created or manipulated; the regulation sets exceptions and a limited form of disclosure, among other things for some artistic, satirical or fictional works. The duty does not verify the identity of the caller, and an offender can breach it. [12] [21] A voice recording is personal data if it relates to an identified or identifiable person. It becomes a special category of biometric data when it is technically processed for the purpose of unique identification. The legal basis and further duties in training or cloning depend on the purpose, the role, the source and the context; they cannot, without the facts of the case, be declared an automatic breach. [13] The Criminal Code of the Czech Republic has no separate offence of “creating a deepfake”. According to the particular conduct, the consequence and the fault, misuse can fulfil, for example, the elements of fraud (Section 209), damage to the rights of another (Section 181) or defamation (Section 184); the legal qualification is neither automatic nor exhaustive. [14] A criminal penalty, moreover, does not by itself return a payment that has already been sent. It does not follow that the law is useless. It follows that it is a different layer from the payment protocol. Whoever melts these two layers into one sentence, “it will be banned”, buys a feeling. They do not buy reversibility. 11. What labelling of synthetic content can do Before a watermark, a person had to check whether the voice sounded right. With a label one checks something more complicated: whether the mark exists, whether it belongs to this file, whether it was stripped by compression, and whether it applies at all to a telephone call, which rarely carries a mark. A label is navigation toward origin. It is not automatic origin. One message can combine three true traces into a false act. The first is a faithful voice. The second is the real name of the boss. The third is real pressure of a deadline. Each part works. The synthesis is the fraud. At other times the system uses a high-quality clone on a channel that would have stopped even a bad clone: a new account and the word “immediately”. A four-step check of a call Existence: is this a live call, or a recording? Authority: is the number from my directory? Support: does the request match the agreed process? Scope: do the amount, the account, the time and the exception fit the rule? The most reliable procedure separates hearing from sending. First a verification through a second channel is created. Only then the payment. If the password does not fit, or the number is not stored, a claim is not promoted to an order merely because the voice sounded right. A security process is meant to shorten the path to verification, not to pass the sound off as evidence. For a harmless family message, hearing may be enough; for a transfer, the last step has to be governed by a rule that a familiar voice cannot bypass. 12. Origin is not hearing, and hearing is not identity The large word “authenticity” is often translated into the sentence “I heard it with my own ears”. Technically a system can accept a sound that convinces the ear. It does not follow that the sound carries an identity. C2PA documentation separates content from credentials: a signature about origin, not an impression about the colour of the voice. [5] Redakční ilustrace · Jiný Kontext Studies of human detection show that hearing is a map in one task. It is not a verdict in another. Mai et al. measured the marking of a fake in the laboratory. [6] A company transfer measures something else: the willingness to break a process under authority. A family bail measures feeling. Court evidence will measure a chain of origin, not how a witness remembers the call. The memory of the product — a recording of the call, a switchboard log, a signature on a file — is another layer. It can help forensics. It also creates a risk of false certainty if the recording itself becomes “evidence” without carrying origin. A file can be generated. A log can exist. That still does not give an identity. How to test an urgent request Put into the exercise a familiar voice of a colleague with a knowingly wrong password. Ask about the contradiction between an account in an SMS and the internal list. Require a delay. Repeat the task in a voice message and on a call. Do not evaluate only whether people “recognised AI”. Record whether the protocol stopped the payment. On a large corpus of calls, a well-designed rule and a smaller relevant exception is usually better than a mechanical “listen more carefully”. The whole company inside a detector is not a strategy of trust. It is often only a more expensive way to hide the decisive “call back” in the middle of a dashboard. 13. Voice privacy is not a switch. It is the whole flow The question “may my voice be cloned?” is important, but too narrow. A person and a company also have to know where recordings of meetings are stored, for how long, who transcribes them, whether records are kept, which third parties process the voice, and whether a public webinar sends raw material into the world. “We do not use it for training” does not mean “nothing is on YouTube”. The differences among consent to dubbing, a recording of a meeting and a public podcast are sharp in the legal texts. [13] It does not follow that every company call is suitable for publication. It follows that raw material cannot be judged by the logo of a platform without the name of the account, the licence and the reach. The practical minimum is a map. It begins with the speaker, continues through the microphone, the cloud, the network, the clone, the call and the payment, and ends at the place where the payment can be stopped or the voice taken down from a public channel. Without this map, a claim about privacy is only a description of one part of the pipe. 14. The price of a recording is the price of raw material, not the price of fraud The market uses several price languages at once. A cloning tool may cost a subscription. A detector another. Training a day. Average vishing damage according to ČBA of more than 19 thousand CZK per attacked client, a peak in one case in the order of millions, a company video call in the order of tens of millions of dollars. [9] [18] A direct comparison of price lists without knowledge of the payment threshold is therefore misleading. A cheap detector can be excellent as a filter of voice inboxes. The same detector can be expensive on a task that the victim hears once, under pressure, and that in the end requires weeks of recovery. Expensive dual approval can be pointless for sums of a hundred crowns. It can be cheaper on a one-off transfer with a high cost of error if it reduces the number of successful emergencies. The real price of an accepted call Channel + time + verification + the cost of a false alarm + the cost of a payment that was sent + recovery + loss of trust + future dependence on one detector. A call is “cheap” only when it stretches the check and can really be used as a prompt, not as an order. That is why it is useful to measure the price per stopped payment , not the price per detected clone. Stopped means that the result met criteria of the process given in advance, even if the ear was wrong. This metric can reverse a ranking that looked unambiguous from the laboratory 73 percent. 15. What to introduce in a family and in a company The first exercise should rest on a concrete scenario, language, telephone channel and financial threshold. The table shows which control regimes to compare under the same conditions; it is not a general ranking of detectors. Need First group of measures Decisive test Unacceptable shortcut Family emergency A password, a ban on bail by telephone, a callback A practice call with no warning of the day Relying on hearing Company payment A second channel, a threshold, a delay, a list of accounts A practice “boss at the notary” An exception for management A video call with authority Verification outside the call; more eyes on the payment The Arup scenario in miniature Trusting the face in the window Political robocall Do not spread it; verify at the primary source Whether the appeal changes behaviour Sharing “so that people know” A public voice of management Less raw material; C2PA where it is possible Whether the webinar is easy to clone A whole podcast without a limit Forensics after the act A recording, a log, origin, not the hearing of a witness Whether the chain will stand A judgment by impression Czech use needs a separate test. An English dataset will not measure whether a clone hit the intonation of “mami”, inflects correctly, or presses for bail in crowns. A test set should contain a voice message, a spoofed number, an SMS with an account, and a scenario in which the correct answer is “I will hang up and call back”. Some teams need more than one layer. One for the family, a second for accounts, a third for public appearances. That is not a failure of standardisation. It is the same decision as using one lock on a bicycle and another on a safe. The condition is that the split is intelligible and that people know where the final authority to pay arises. 16. A fourteen-day protocol that will say more than a detector A defence can be built without a six-month tender and without an impulsive purchase. A short, disciplined pilot is enough. Its aim is not to prove that a detector can do something impressive. The aim is to find situations in which hearing fails, and to see whether the process can stop the harm. Fourteen days from impression to a rule Days 1–2: Write down 20 to 40 real payment and emergency scenarios, their frequency and the cost of error. Days 3–4: Prepare the same inputs, passwords, lists of accounts and a scoring sheet. Days 5–7: Play each important scenario at least three times. Keep a register: hearing, password, callback, payment. Days 8–10: Check limits at the bank, delay, logs, deletion of recordings and public raw material on the web. Days 11–12: Calculate the price of a stopped payment, including false alarms. Day 13: Stress: a voice message, a video call, “immediately”, a new account, a child, management. Day 14: Decide according to the matrix, document exceptions and set a date for the next review. What needs to be tested A channel test repeats the same request in a call, a voice message and a video, because each carries different traces. A threshold test examines whether the process contains an exception for management. A data test separates a public webinar, an internal recording and a live telephone call. The pilot has conditions for elimination. For example: a single unannounced payment from a voice, acceptance of a new account without a second channel, an inability to stop an outgoing payment, or a detector that cannot be turned off when it shouts all the time. A high average score of the ear must not override an error whose impact the organisation cannot accept. The last output is not the name of a detector. It is an operating rule: one does not pay from a voice, the password holds, a callback is mandatory, raw material is limited, and the decision will be opened again in a quarter of a year. Models change. Without a revision date, even a good protocol turns into a superstition. 17. Two similar calls can have a different regime With a voice it is especially important not to blur the boundary among family, company and a public appearance. The same person can read a fairy tale on a network on Tuesday and approve invoices on Wednesday. Raw material from Tuesday serves Wednesday’s clone. Privacy and thresholds differ. The cost of error differs. The difference is not cosmetic. The exercise has to record in which regime the test is run, what the threshold is, and who may release the payment. Otherwise the company tests hearing on a clean recording and by mistake presents it as a security property of Monday’s emergency SMS. Before sending money after a voice Hang up. Call back the stored number. Require a password or a detail that is not on the video. Do not accept a new account from the same channel. Hold the delay even if the voice is in a hurry. In companies: a second person, a list of accounts, a ban on the exception “because it is the director”. The largest advantage therefore need not be a detector. It can be the boredom of the process. And the largest weakness need not be synthesis. It can be a genuine voice that nevertheless never breaks its own rule — until the rule does not exist. 18. Loss of trust after a fraudulent call The first generation of fraudulent calls sold a fake bank. The next sold a fake grandson. Today’s tools sell something larger: the fidelity of the voices of people we already have in the directory. That is why attackers do not compete only for the best vocoder. They compete for context. For public recordings, for the habit of paying from a telephone, for an exception for management, for the fact that until recently “hearing it” was still enough. The more convenient the voice is as an order, the higher the price of leaving that habit. People stop distinguishing a relationship from the channel in which they heard the relationship. That does not mean that voice synthesis is bad. It is precisely synthesis that gives a voice to those who have lost it, and that saves work where there is consent. It means that it should be used deliberately. A family and a company need a portable password, an emergency procedure that does not depend on hearing, a limit on raw material, and a regular test of whether the original reasons for trusting a call still hold. The best system is therefore not the one that never errs. We do not have such hearing. Nor is it the system with the highest laboratory percentage, the best watermark, or the strictest law after the act. It is the system whose controls match the real payment and whose errors are visible, reversible, and economically and humanly bearable . At the moment when a voice only says hello, we are choosing a channel. The moment it asks for money, a password, or silence about an election, we are choosing a structure of trust. And then the question is no longer: “Will I recognise a deepfake by hearing?” What decides is whether we verify the request through a second channel before trust in a familiar voice turns into an irreversible payment. — Jiný Kontext

items.title: The proposed 24 billion package for health insurers is not yet 24 billion of care
items.subtitle: On 8 June 2026 the government approved a draft package meant to strengthen the public health-insurance system in 2027 by 24 billion koruna: roughly 21 billion through a higher payment for state-paid insured persons and about 3 billion by a transfer from operating funds. It is a proposal, not an act in force, and a higher receipt alone does not guarantee a shorter wait or a new practice.

items.body: The government’s total of 24 billion joins two different movements of money: about 21 billion in a proposed higher state payment and about 3 billion moved out of the insurers’ operating funds. Neither flow by itself determines the number of practices, contracted capacity or free appointments. The proposal may improve the system’s balance sheet and the availability of care may still not change at the same pace. What we know / What we don't know What we know: The proposal approved by the government on 8 June 2026 combines about 21 billion in a higher state payment and about 3 billion moved from the insurers’ operating funds. Chamber of Deputies print 235 was not, as of 31 August 2026, an approved act. What we don't know: Until the legislative process is finished and the reimbursement rules and health-insurance plans are known, the final receipt of the individual insurers and the effect on waiting times and the regional network cannot be determined. 1. A transfer that is not yet care Imagine a meeting about state-paid insured persons — children, pensioners and the other groups for whom the state pays the premium. The health minister points to 21 billion and says the system will break even in 2027. The finance minister points to an outlay of the state budget and says automatic indexation is being switched off for two years. The director of an insurer points to a deficit in the basic fund. A general practitioner from a district points to a full appointment book and a missing successor. A mother of two points to a list of dentists who are not registering. The journalist has the sentence “more money into healthcare” in the notebook. The journalist wants to know whether that will shorten the queue. At first glance this is an argument about generosity. In fact each person is describing a different object. The first is talking about the assessment base. The second, about the fiscal calendar. The third, about the insurer’s liquidity. The fourth, about a post. The fifth, about travel distance. The journalist is comparing a headline with a waiting room. A statement about “billions for healthcare” has to say whether it is a state transfer, a shift between funds, a repair of a balance sheet, or payment for a specific service. Only then can the reimbursement rules, the contracted network and staff capacity be followed. The state budget, the insurer’s account and a free chair at the dentist are three different levels. A comparison has first to say which of them the proposal is meant to affect and by which figure the effect will be recognised. A premium is not care. Care is not a network. A network is not a doctor. And 21 billion is not a queue in a waiting room. — Jiný Kontext 2. How the proposed 24 billion package is put together When “24 billion extra” appears on the screen, it is easy to imagine a single new payment into practices. The official government press release uses the total of 24 billion, in simplified form, for the whole package. [15] The parameters of Chamber of Deputies print 235, however, give about 21 billion in a higher payment for state-paid insured persons; another roughly 3 billion is to arise from a transfer out of the insurers’ operating funds. These are two mechanisms, not one item of the state budget. Five layers of one transfer Assessment base and rate: the state remits 13.5% of the set base for each state-paid insured person. Print 235 proposes, from 1 January 2027, to raise the base from CZK 16 206 to CZK 18 362 and the monthly payment from CZK 2 188 to CZK 2 479, that is by CZK 291. [1] [2] [5] Volume of the transfer: with roughly six million state-paid insured persons the explanatory memorandum counts on about CZK 21 billion extra into the public health-insurance system. That is the system of insurers, not VZP alone. [1] [5] The insurers’ balances: the money would enter the funds. The materials for the proposal model, for 2026, a system deficit of around CZK 15 billion and, for 2027, a balanced position at spending of about CZK 603.1 billion . That is an assumption in the proposal, not an actual result. [1] [6] The reimbursement decree: the rules for how much is paid per point, service, centre and regulation. A transfer without a decree does not determine where the koruna will go. [10] Capacity in the field: a contract with a provider, a post, travel distance, a willingness to register new insured persons. A billion will not open this layer by itself. [3] [7] The state payment sets an important part of the receipts, but it is not the only actor. Collection of premiums from wages may grow more slowly than costly treatment. Operating funds can hold a reserve outside care. The reimbursement decree can add to a centre and not add to a rural practice. A doctor can have a contract and not have a successor. This is where the first error of most public comparisons arises. The headline announces a contest of “strengthening care”, but in fact it compares the insurers’ receipts with the journey to a paediatrician. Or, conversely, it measures a balanced position and issues the result as a verdict on availability. An honest comparison must state not only the 21 billion, but also the year, the population of state-paid insured persons, whether the figure is a receipt or a service, and whether it was calculated by the ministry, an insurer or ÚZIS. That is not an argument about definitions. The cut of the layers decides where to turn when disappointment comes. If the queue does not disappear, a post may have been missing. If the insurer reports a surplus, a deficit may have been patched. If 2028 freezes the payment, the manual quarrel may return. The sentence “we put 21 billion here” is the start of a diagnosis, not its end. Illustrative diagram: The same billion can, in another fund, under another decree and in another district, produce another result for the patient. 3. The best injection is the one whose failure you will see A government usually looks for a measure with the highest chance of an intelligible title. That is reasonable, but incomplete. Just as important is what failure looks like, whether it can be recognised and whether it is reversible. An insurer’s accounting surplus is a visible repair. A missing dentist in a district is an expensive error that the transfer may not measure at all. A freeze of the payment for 2028 can be reversed politically. You cannot relocate a board-certified doctor in one budget year. Type of failure What it looks like How to test it What limits the harm Swapping transfer and care “21 billion = a shorter queue” Did waiting times fall, or did only the receipt rise? Separate the fund and the network Swapping a jump and the automatic A one-off 21 billion versus 3.2 billion from indexation Which rule applies in 2028? The calendar of the automatic Repair instead of capacity A balanced position, the same number of posts NRPZS, ÚZIS, not only the insurer’s surplus Staff indicators The decree filter The money sticks in another segment Where does the reimbursement actually flow? Segmentation of reimbursements Geography A plus at headquarters, zero in the district Contracts and registrations by ORP Travel distance, not the Czech average That also changes the evaluative question. We are not asking only whether 21 billion was missing for liquidity. We are asking which promise will fail in a way we will catch in the field. The ministry can tolerate a jump that patches a 15 billion deficit, because otherwise reimbursements would seize up. A patient cannot tolerate a balanced position becoming proof of an available dentist. Analysts can accept switching automatic indexation off as a fiscal compromise. They cannot issue it as a reform of the network. The volume of the package is only an input. For a check it is necessary to know the calendar of the payment, the accounting path, the reimbursement decision and a measurable effect on the network. Without those steps a change in availability cannot be inferred from the headline amount. 4. What the state transfer measures The state payment is needed because it replaces part of premium collection for people without taxable income from work. The state pays for children, pensioners, students, the unemployed and other groups named in the act — in the communication on print 235 and on the regulation for 2026 the working figure is of the order of about six million persons. That is the number of state-paid insured persons, not the number of patients in a waiting room. [2] [5] The problem begins when one transfer starts to stand for the whole of availability. The explanatory memorandum and the Chamber debate of 8 July 2026 describe the aim of restoring financial balance. The opposition, in the same reading, objected that without changes to the network the figure is not enough. Both sentences can be true. They measure a different object. [1] [6] Five facts without which 21 billion is only an advertising number The exact payment per person and the assessment base, not only the sum. The period: 2026 versus the 2027 proposal, the 2028 freeze, the return of the automatic in 2029. The population of state-paid insured persons, not “healthcare as a whole”. Whether the figure is a system receipt, an outlay of a state chapter, or a reimbursement to a provider. What the number does not measure: posts, travel distance, waiting times. For an assessment, therefore, a small breakdown of the flow matters more than someone else’s overall ranking of “we have strengthened care”. Thirty real contracts in one district can say more than one billion-item. A public transfer will help choose the debate about liquidity. The decision about care has to be made by the network. 5. Compare flows, not headlines The table follows individual messages according to whether they describe a state payment, an accounting fund, a reimbursement or available capacity. Each row therefore answers a different check question. Redakční ilustrace · Jiný Kontext Message Main object What to check Typical reason for use “+21 bn into healthcare” A receipt of public insurance That it is not VZP as the only insurer A fiscal headline [1] “+CZK 291 per person” The monthly state payment The base 16 206 → 18 362 Kč A parameter of the act [1] [2] “A balanced year 2027” The system balance at ~603 bn of spending The 2026 deficit of ~15 bn Liquidity [1] “Automatic off” The 2027–2028 rule vs. return 2029 3.2 bn that indexation would have given Fiscal time [1] [4] “More available care” The network and waiting times ÚZIS, NRPZS, the chambers The field, not the fund [3] [7] The rows are not a verdict on honesty. The same minister can use three objects in one sitting. The map is meant to prevent a different error: that CZK 291 becomes a practice and a balanced position becomes a reform. How to read the diagram: Payment, fund and service are not three names for the same thing. The diagram separates the state transfer, the insurers’ accounts and the providers’ capacity. 6. Print 235: a proposed jump of 291 koruna per person The government approved the proposal on 8 June 2026 and it was submitted to the Chamber on 23 June as print 235. In the first reading on 8 July the Chamber rejected the accelerated procedure under § 90(2). As of 31 August 2026 the proposal was not an approved act and the Health Committee, as the committee in charge, had not, according to the Chamber history, debated it; further debate was possible from 7 September. All amounts for 2027 are therefore parameters of the proposal. [1] [6] [15] Key parameters from the materials on the print: Indicator Position in 2026 Proposal from 1. 1. 2027 Change Assessment base CZK 16 206 CZK 18 362 +CZK 2 156 Monthly state payment (13.5%) CZK 2 188 CZK 2 479 +CZK 291 Estimated extra volume — — +CZK 21 bn The government regulation for 2026 had already raised the base from CZK 15 749 to CZK 16 206 and the payment from CZK 2 127 to CZK 2 188; the Ministry of Finance put the fiscal effect of that indexation at about CZK 4.4 billion, assuming about six million persons. Print 235 is a different movement: a legislative jump, not the ordinary automatic. [2] [5] Rough arithmetic explains the difference between the headline figures. Six million persons times CZK 291 a month times twelve months gives about CZK 21 billion in a higher state payment. The total of 24 billion arises only when about three billion moved from operating funds is added. This is a multiplication of public parameters, not an audit of the receipts of the individual insurers; the number of state-paid insured persons changes during the year. [1] [2] [12] [15] The materials on the print at the same time put total system spending in 2027 at about CZK 603.1 billion. In that view the year-on-year rise in spending is larger than the 21 billion of receipt from the state payment itself. It does not follow that the jump is not enough. It follows that the 2027 balance also counts on other receipts — above all on collection of premiums from wages — and on a pace of spending that the transfer does not steer. The headline “21 billion into healthcare” therefore does not measure the whole account of the year. It measures one side of one item. [1] [6] 7. An indexation automatic that is being switched off The most visible parameter is not CZK 291, but the proposed suspension of indexation. The indexation automatic introduced from 2024 raises the assessment base according to the rise in prices and half of the rise in the real wage. The materials on the print estimate that for 2027 it would have brought about CZK 3.2 billion ; the proposal is to replace it for 2027 and 2028 with a one-off jump and to freeze the payment in 2028. The automatic returns from 2029 only if the amendment is adopted in this form. [1] [4] [5] The proposed construction is a swap of a higher payment in 2027 for a two-year interruption of the rule. From the materials the real value of the frozen payment in 2028 cannot be determined in advance; it will depend, among other things, on the path of prices, wages and the number of insured persons. The health minister warned in the first reading that without effect from January 2027 the insurers would not draw up insurance plans. A colleague in the government, in the same debate, spoke of the need for structural changes. Both sentences can be true. One measures liquidity. The other, the network. [6] The 2024 automatic replaced part of the earlier manual setting. If the amendment is adopted, a two-year interruption will reduce the predictability given by the formula and further development will again depend on a legal and political decision. That is an effect of the proposal, not the present state. [4] [5] How to read the 2027–2029 calendar According to the proposal: 2027 means about 21 billion in a higher state payment instead of the estimated 3.2 billion from the automatic; 2028 is to hold CZK 2 479 a month; from 2029 the automatic is to return. This calendar is not law in force until the amendment has passed through the legislative process. 8. Repairing a deficit is not new capacity The materials on print 235 model a system deficit in 2026 of around CZK 15 billion and a balance in 2027 at spending of about CZK 603.1 billion. From that it can be inferred that a substantial function of the proposal is to stabilise existing liabilities; it is not possible, however, to say exactly which koruna will cover the deficit and which a new service. This is a model in the explanatory memorandum, not a measured result for 2027. [1] [6] Health-insurance plans and the insurers’ reports will only later show how the higher receipt entered the basic funds and reimbursements. It does not follow from the proposal that every koruna will create a new service, nor that the whole volume will merely patch the deficit. Both claims need subsequent data. [8] [9] System spending is also shaped by population ageing, centre-based medicines, oncology care and hospital pay. SÚKL and the reimbursement agenda for costly medicines are a different mechanism from the assessment base. If those costs grow faster than receipts, a higher state payment can stabilise the balance only temporarily; the concrete result, however, will be shown only by the insurance plans and actual accounts. [8] [19] Act No. 48/1997 Coll. sets the insured person’s entitlement and the framework of the network. The entitlement exists even when the insurer’s account is in the red — and it exists even when it is in the black and a doctor is missing in the district. The transfer changes the ability to pay the entitlement. It does not automatically change the ability to perform it. [16] 9. The reimbursement decree is a filter, not a vending machine Even when the insurer has the money, reimbursements are shaped by the decree, contracts and regulatory rules. Without knowing their form, a distribution between centre treatment, inpatient and outpatient care or regional bonuses cannot be inferred from the transfer. The reimbursement rules can, moreover, change independently of print 235. [10] Redakční ilustrace · Jiný Kontext What has to be tested after the credit The first test: which reimbursement segment is growing year on year. The second: whether a bonus for underserved regions exists and whether it is drawn. The third: whether a contract with a new provider in the district has been added, or only the reimbursement to existing ones has risen. A product that holds a balanced position on paper can look, in the field, like a more expensive same network. The decree is annual. The transfer from print 235 is a multi-year calendar with a freeze. A mismatch of periods is another filter: even if the 21 billion arrived in January, the reimbursement rules can change in December and again the next year. A reader who judges only the regulation on the assessment base does not see that tap. A reader who judges only the decree does not see the automatic switched off. An honest reading needs both. 10. Availability is measured by the network, not the balance In the Czech Republic availability is often decided not by the balance on an insurer’s account, but by the geographical and contractual network. The Czech Dental Chamber has repeatedly pointed to regional differences in the registration of new patients. ÚZIS records providers and the capacities of the specialties. The OECD, in Health at a Glance , ranks spending and outcomes, not travel distance from a particular postcode. Three maps. One headline will not merge them. [3] [7] [13] An illustration, not a report. In January 2027 the insurer receives CZK 291 more per state-paid insured person and the basic fund moves out of the red. In the same month a mother in a border district phones practices within tens of kilometres and hears that they are not registering new patients on the insurance. The accounting state can be a success. The factual state is the same network. The figures 291 and 21 billion are from print 235. The list of unsuccessful calls is a mechanism, not an ÚZIS census. Statutory travel times and the insurers’ contracting policy are exactly the place where the transfer either turns into care or stays on the balance sheet. The check of this layer is not in the regulation on the assessment base. [1] [10] 11. A staff ceiling cannot be credited by a transfer Higher reimbursements can finance a service or a treatment, but they will not by themselves shorten the time of specialist training. ÚZIS and the professional organisations describe regional and age differences in capacity; this article, however, does not verify a single nationwide age average, nor prove an empty succession in every district. Staff capacity is therefore a separate indicator beside the system’s receipt. [3] [11] [14] The Czech Medical Chamber, in its opinions on hospitals and primary care, speaks of shifts, board certification and limits on posts. Here too a chamber opinion is not a count of posts. It is a signal that a reader of the transfer should look for beside the explanatory memorandum. [14] Children and older people form a substantial part of the state-paid insured, but the exact composition has to be documented by current statistics. The effect of the proposal on paediatricians, GPs or dentists has to be measured by contracts, capacities and availability by region; CZK 291 per person does not prove it. [3] [22] The time needed to prepare a doctor is longer than a legislative year. Board certification, a selection procedure, a move, the equipment of a practice. Even if the reimbursement decree offered a higher capitation in an underserved district tomorrow, the result would be on the order of years, not on the order of a press conference. 21 billion can pay that capitation. It cannot shorten board certification. Whoever promises both in one sentence promises two objects. 12. Three billion from operating funds is a different shift Part of the proposed package is a lowering of the ceiling on the insurers’ operating funds, which is to move about CZK 3 billion into the care funds. That is a shift inside the system, not a new outlay of the state budget. Together with about 21 billion in a higher state payment it creates the government’s total of 24 billion; the actual shift and its effect will be verifiable only from the legal wording and the insurers’ accounts. [8] [9] [15] The National Budget Council follows the state’s mandatory payments for insured persons as an item that returns every year. Switching automatic indexation off unhooks it from inflation and wages for two years. The return in 2029 hooks it again. The valve of the operating funds is one-off. The automatic is a rule. The rule decides the next quarrel more than three billion. [9] 13. Where to check the effect of the package Before print 235 the reader had to check whether indexation was enough. With the print the reader checks something more complicated: whether 21 billion is a receipt or care; whether 3.2 billion is the alternative of the automatic; whether 2028 is a freeze; whether 603 billion of spending is capacity. The headline is a navigation to the flow. It is not automatic evidence about a waiting room. Joining three documented figures can create an undocumented conclusion: +CZK 291 per person, a model-balanced year 2027 and about six million state-paid insured persons, including children, do not yet mean that children will receive more care. For that a change in reimbursements and in the network of paediatricians has to be shown. A four-step check of a billion Existence: the figure is in the print, a regulation, or the explanatory memorandum. Object: a payment, a fund, a reimbursement, or a post. Support: year, population, unit. Scope: what is missing — 2028, the decree, the district. 14. The price of the premium is the price of the raw material, not the price of the service The market uses several languages. The state pays a monthly amount. The insurer books funds. The provider sees a point and a regulation. The patient sees an appointment. A direct comparison of 21 billion with “strengthening care”, without a working method, misleads. Redakční ilustrace · Jiný Kontext A cheap automatic (3.2 billion) can be expensive if 15 billion is missing in 2026 for reimbursements. An expensive jump (21 billion) can be cheap as liquidity and expensive as a postponement of reform. A cheap balanced position can be expensive if a freeze in the inflation year 2028 stands behind it. The real price of care received State payment + collection from wages + reimbursement rules + a post + travel distance + waiting time. Care is cheap only when it can be booked. The cost includes volatility. If the same service can be booked once in five attempts, the average price of care is not the reimbursement in the decree. If the insurer exhausts a segment limit, the cost is waiting. It is therefore useful to measure the price of the appointment obtained , not the price of a billion credited. That metric can reverse an order that looked unambiguous from print 235. 15. What to watch before the transfer becomes care A check has first to say whether a state outlay, an insurer’s balance, a reimbursement to a provider or the availability of care is being verified. The table assigns each question its first measurable figure. Question First object The decisive test Unacceptable shortcut Can the insurers carry 2027? The balance, 15 vs. 21 bn Insurance plans, not the headline Saying that it is care What happens in 2028? A freeze of the payment Inflation vs. CZK 2 479 Making 2027 the rule Where do reimbursements flow? The decree, the segments The year-on-year change in reimbursements Assuming an even rain Have practices been added? NRPZS, contracts Districts with children and older people The Czech average Have waiting times shortened? ÚZIS, the insurers Specific services “More money = a shorter queue” Is the automatic returning? The text of the act toward 2029 Whether the amendment holds the date Forgetting the switch For Czech use a separate geography test is required. A nationwide 21 billion will not measure Jeseník or Bruntál. The test set should include the payment, the fund, the decree, the contract and the appointment — and the sentence “the source is not enough” if waiting times are missing. 16. A short test after the proposed package is introduced An assessment can be made without arguments about character. A short procedure is enough. The aim is not to prove that the injection sounds good. The aim is to find a swap of objects. Seven steps from the title to the sentence Write down the object: payment, fund, reimbursement, network, or appointment. Write down the year: 2026, 2027, 2028, 2029. Separate the 21 billion from the 3.2 billion of the automatic. Separate VZP from the system of seven insurers. Check the decree, not only the regulation on the base. Take one district and one specialty. Only then write whether care has been strengthened. Three tests of availability The first is accounting: is the fund in surplus? The second is contractual: has a contract been added? The third is about time: has the appointment shortened? A measure that passes only the first test has met liquidity. It has not met the headline about care. An elimination error: a single sentence that turns CZK 291 into a new dentist without data on registration. The pilot should also have a revision date. Insurance plans, the decree and the network change every year. Without a date even an honest stabilisation of 2027 gradually turns into the superstition that “21 billion went into healthcare, so care is solved”. The last output is not a winner between liquidity and the waiting room. It is a rule: which layer is paid this year, which is measured in the district, and when the automatic will be opened again. 17. The OECD measures spending. It does not measure the journey to the dentist Health at a Glance ranks the Czech Republic by spending, risk factors and selected outcomes. It is a map of international comparison. It is not a map of travel distance from a particular municipality. A country can be solid in oncology and cardiovascular outcomes and still have holes in primary care. Both statements can be true if they are not read as one. [13] The National Budget Council and the health-insurance plans add another axis: the state’s mandatory payment and sustainability. That too does not measure a dentist’s chair. Whoever adds the OECD, the NRR and 21 billion into the sentence “we have European healthcare, so the injection is enough” merges three definitions. Whoever turns a hole in a district into proof that the transfer is worthless merges them the other way. [8] [9] [13] Eurostat measures health-care expenditure in the national accounts. Again a different definition from public health insurance in the Czech Republic, which is only part of the whole — beside household out-of-pocket payments and other sources. An international “low share of spending in GDP” is therefore not automatically praise of the efficiency of print 235. It can also be a map of what the system does not do, or of what the patient pays. An honest comparison must say which account is being added up internationally. [13] [18] 18. A two-year interruption of the indexation automatic The first generation of quarrels sold the amount of the payment for a state-paid insured person. The next generation sold the indexation automatic. Today’s amendment sells something larger: a one-off jump in exchange for a switch on the rule. The contest is therefore not only for the 21 billion. The contest is over whether next year there will again be a manual deal. The more comfortable the headline about strengthening care becomes, the higher the price of the error. The journalist stops distinguishing the fund from the waiting room. The minister stops distinguishing 2027 from 2028. The patient stops distinguishing a promise from an appointment. That does not mean the transfer is a bad thing. Precisely that transfer can keep reimbursements going. It means it should be read consciously. The public needs a portable legend: how much per person, which year, whether the automatic is running, where the decree flows and whether a contract has been added in the district. The best injection is therefore not the one that never leaves a deficit. With population ageing and costly treatment we do not have that. Nor is it the injection with the highest title. It is the injection whose object matches the question and whose gaps — the freeze, the network, the staff — are visible, reversible and politically bearable . At the moment we ask only “how much did we put in?”, we are choosing a headline. At the moment we read the flow from the budget to the appointment, we are choosing a structure of responsibility. And then the question is no longer: “Why is the 21 billion not visible in the waiting room?” What decides is to separate the higher state payment, the internal shift of funds and the actual effect on reimbursements and the network — and not to forget that this is still a proposal. — Jiný Kontext

items.title: The 389 billion deficit proposal means a year-on-year deepening
items.subtitle: On 31 August 2026 the Ministry of Finance submitted to the government a draft state budget for 2027 with a deficit of CZK 389 billion. The figure is below four hundred billion, yet CZK 79 billion higher than the approved deficit for 2026. It is a proposal before government and parliamentary debate, not an approved budget.
